subject: general
question: The famous Sheesh Mahal in Punjab was built by which of the following rulers?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maharaja Narinder Singh.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Maharaja Narinder Singh** ruled the** Sikh Empire** from **1824 to 1840.**
 
• **Sheesh Mahal**, also known as the Palace of Mirrors, is located in the city of **Patiala in Punjab**, India.
 
• The palace was built in the **19th century** and is known for its exquisite **mirror work, **which **reflects light **and creates a **dazzling effect.**
 
• Maharaja Narinder Singh was a **patron of the arts** and commissioned many buildings and artworks during his reign.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information __**

 
• **Maharaja Sawai Pratap Singh** was a **ruler of Jaipur **and is known for building the famous** Hawa Mahal. **
 
• **Rana Kumbha** was a ruler of **Mewar **and is known for building the **Kumbhalgarh Fort.**
 
• **Raja Man Singh-I** was a general in the **Mughal Empire** and is known for his** military campaigns and architectural works**.
